items.label: FIGURE 4.3
items.title: Data accessibility scores for countries by income categories
items.content: The figure consists of two horizontal bar charts (panels a and b) showing median ODIN scores (0-100) by income category. Panel a: Overall ODIN scores by category. Legend: Poverty and income, All categories. High-income: Poverty and income approx. 65, All categories approx. 65. Upper-middle-income: Poverty and income approx. 50, All categories approx. 52. Lower-middle-income: Poverty and income approx. 42, All categories approx. 45. Low-income: Poverty and income approx. 38, All categories approx. 40. Panel b: ODIN openness and coverage scores. Legend: Openness score, Coverage score. High-income: Openness score approx. 72, Coverage score approx. 55. Upper-middle-income: Openness score approx. 55, Coverage score approx. 50. Lower-middle-income: Openness score approx. 40, Coverage score approx. 45. Low-income: Openness score approx. 38, Coverage score approx. 40. Source: Open Data Watch 2023. Note: ODIN = Open Data Inventory. Panel a shows the median ODIN overall scores for all categories and the poverty and income categories. Panel b shows the median ODIN openness and coverage scores for all categories. ODIN score goes from 0 to 100. Fixed income group classifications from 2022 are used.
